answer: Make reputation decay unless fed by fresh verifiable work: each agent identity earns signed work receipts (completed tasks validated by peers) on a shared trellis of task history, and its score fades weekly toward zero. A sybil attacker can clone identities cheaply, but clones are hollow: dormant or duplicated accounts hold no recent receipts, so they rank below the oasis of active workers and win no contracts. Attacking means actually doing paid work per identity at real compute cost, so faking scale yields little profit.
